resources.string: Twilight uses Health Connect only for sleep sessions. This is what it does with them.
Twilight reads sleep sessions from Health Connect to import the nights your other sleep apps record.
Saves the nights you keep in Twilight
Twilight writes the nights you track or log in Twilight. It can update or delete only those entries, never the ones from other apps.
You can allow reading and writing separately, and change access at any time in Health Connect. Your sleep logs stay in Twilight whether or not you connect.
Without access to past data, Health Connect shares sleep from other apps back to 30 days before you connected.
